digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass orchestration and prompt cache optimization
propositions: Plan content must appear byte-identically at the start of both Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier system prompts to enable provider-side prefix cache reuse within ephemeral TTL
Pass-1 and verifier templates must render from a single source (prompts.shared_plan_prefix) to structurally enforce byte-identity and prevent drift
Finding listing must remain in user message (instructions) not system prompt so verifier prefix is stable across chunks and runs
Pass-1 warm gate must measure actual cached prefix (preamble + plan) not plan alone to correctly threshold against CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS floor
Exhaustiveness directive (enumerate every independent defect in this run) must inject into every Pass-1 entry point via the shared preamble to enforce complete findings per loop iteration
Verifier templates must drop both plan variable and volatile marker, converting entire rendered body to stable system segment with no split
